requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5567-8249--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5567-8249--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

549-4779-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-4779-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-4779-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

147-3905-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-3967.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
728-3293-5282.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

618-1938-3899.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

618-1938-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-2999.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-6719.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

792-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

4050-7084-7885.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4050-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
4050-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2577-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-1671-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-1671-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5147-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

147-413-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Infuse with Vitality triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

856-997-2173-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-997-2173-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-997-2173-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3440-4867-6797-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3946-5967-6762.notablePrerequisites: Exploration Broodship has three or more charge counters on it.
3946-5967-6762.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2428-3591-4444-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2428-3591-4444-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

2047-2707-3617-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2047-2707-3617-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Walk onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1809-1987-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Returned Pastcaller.
When Revolutionist and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

116-1603-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Evil Twin on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Evil Twin do not have summoning sickness.
116-1603-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Evil Twin.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Evil Twin.
Activate Evil Twin by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Evil Twin ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

457-4068-5159-5491.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
457-4068-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4068-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1737-2099-2793.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat each turn.

147-2438-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-277-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-277-2893-4500.description:
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the basic land enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Kazandu  trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-1777-2034-4558.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature with mana value 2 or greater.
147-1777-2034-4558.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or greater.
Extus triggers, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Burnt Offering.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Burnt Offering copy, adding at least {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If the sacrificed creature had mana value 3 or greater, this combo nets infinite black and red mana.

1594-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

232-2136-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
232-2136-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrasks enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding fifteen {R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

2034-3517-4680.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3517-4680.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Tainted Observer triggers, causing you to pay {2} to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrifcing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to proliferate.
Repeat from step 3.

1984-3489-3752.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1984-3489-3752.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the creature is unblocked, activate Phage's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Phage onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Phage enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Resolve Phage's ability, not losing the game due to Angel's Grace.
Deal combat damage with Phage.
Phage triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

11-1467-1987-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to blue is at least five.
You have not copied a spell with Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
11-1467-1987-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Nykthos.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Nykthos.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Ghostly Flicker.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Ghostly Flicker, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Nykthos, and returning the original Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Nykthos.
Repeat.

2034-2178-5251.description:
Activate Emmara using the ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff by paying {2} and tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Emmara triggers, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

2174-3147-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3147-4222.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
